question: In the number \(74982.1035\) the value of the place occupied by the digit \(9\) is how many times as great as the value of the place occupied by the digit \(3?\)
solution:
The digit \(9\) occupies the hundreds place, whose value is \(100\). The digit \(3\) occupies the thousandths place, whose value is \(0.001\).

The requested factor is the quotient of these place values. Multiply both the dividend and divisor by \(1000\) to make the divisor \(1\):
\[
\frac{100}{0.001}
=\frac{100\cdot1000}{0.001\cdot1000}
=\boxed{100{,}000}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
